env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A group whose body shares its line with the closing brace, alone or
# nested in another group, with a plain call or a child block, ejects to
# Go that builds and prints what the native run prints. The ejected
# module builds and runs with go and with go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
cd m
logos run .
stdout '^15$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -o $WORK/upstream$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/upstream$GOEXE
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/grouponeline

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"sync/atomic"
)

var total atomic.Int64

func add(n int64) {
	total.Add(n)
}

func run(ctx context.Context) error {
	go group (ctx) { go add(1) }
	go group (ctx) {
		go add(2)
		go group (ctx) { go add(3) }
	}
	go group (ctx) { go add(4) } // comment after a one-line group
	go group (ctx) { go { add(5) } }
	return nil
}

func main() {
	if err := run(context.Background()); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("run failed:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	fmt.Println(total.Load())
}
